introduction: WOOKTOOL 25ft steel tape measures are suited to hardware, DIY and construction supply programs that require an imperial or dual-unit measuring format. Buyers can define blade presentation, case style, branding and retail packaging before sampling.
Provide the desired blade unit, width, expected quantity, market, logo and package direction for a focused quotation and sample review.

faq.question: Can a 25ft tape use metric and imperial units?
faq.answer: Imperial, metric or dual-scale layouts can be reviewed according to the destination market.

faq.question: Who typically sources 25ft tape measures?
faq.answer: They are commonly considered for North American hardware, DIY, construction and private-label programs.

faq.question: What should be checked before bulk approval?
faq.answer: Confirm blade length and printing, lock and retraction, hook rivet, case assembly, logo and packaging details.

faq.question: Can the packaging carry a private label?
faq.answer: Yes. Logo, barcode, color box, blister card and carton mark requirements can be discussed.
